hypotheses.binder: (htame : ∀ q ∈ Smin, q ≠ p → (GaloisRepAdic.ofResidualGaloisRep ρbar).IsUnipotentOnInertiaAt q)
hypotheses.justification: A search of the file finds `htame` only once, in its own binder (line 211). No other binder and nothing in the conclusion refers to it, and the proof never uses it. The proof also has no tactic that picks up hypotheses from the context on its own (no `assumption`, `simp [*]`, `simp_all` or `aesop`). The one `omega` call only proves a fact about natural numbers, and `htame` is not a linear arithmetic fact, so `omega` cannot use it. The only conjunct of the conclusion that `htame` could matter for is `∀ q ∈ Smin, q.Prime → q ≠ p → ρ.IsUnipotentOnInertiaAt q`. The proof gets it from `GaloisRepAdic.isUnipotentOnInertiaAt_twist` and `HeckeRing.isUnipotentOnInertiaAt_of_dvd_of_not_isUnramifiedAt`, using `hNmin`, `hq2`, `hSmin` and `hmin`; `htame` is not passed to either. So deleting the binder leaves the proof unchanged and it still compiles.
